[[File:Zeke chathead.png|left]]
'''Zeke''' is the owner of [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]] in [[Al Kharid]]. He sells [[scimitar]]s up to [[mithril scimitar|mithril]].

If asked about [[dragon scimitar]]s, Zeke will say ''"A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar? No way, man! The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me. Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar."'' This is a reference to the [[Monkey Madness I]] [[quest]] which must be completed to wield a dragon scimitar, and in which the player pretends to be the uncle of a [[Monkey Child]]. If the player has completed the quest, they will respond with ''"Hmmm, funny you should say that..."''.

Zeke plays an important role in the [[2021 Birthday event]]. [[Duke Horacio]] had heard Zeke's trap designs could safely trap monkeys and sent the player to talk to Zeke, where Zeke helps the player by supplying [[premium banana]]s and [[bamboo]] for the player at his shop to create [[monkey cage]]s. Later he was also invited by Duke Horacio to join the party as [[Zeke (2021 Birthday event)|one of the party guests]].
